items.title: New AI attack hides data-theft prompts in downscaled images
items.description: Researchers have developed a novel attack that steals user data by injecting malicious prompts in images processed by AI systems before delivering them to a large language model. [...]

items.title: Hackers Lied In Wait, Then Knocked Out Iran Ship Comms
items.description: Lab-Dookhtegen claims major attack on more than 60 cargo ships and oil tankers belonging to two Iranian companies on US sanctions list.
